Mechanical blockers, independent of my judgment:
- The public guard has never covered apps/, because the projection is packages-only. Its relational layer would currently fail on 78 regular apps files, mostly from r16 nav glyphs and r05/r03.
- Its path layer refuses the 103 symlinks, which would have to be materialised, and the 76 binaries (64 .tgz, 9 .wav, 3 .png), which need digest allow entries.
- The humans.txt obfuscated email evades the email regex.
limits:

- I did not read every line of the 5,115-line agenttool.jsonld or of the long technical reference HTML/MD (memory, identity, runtime, MARKETPLACE, MATHOS and similar). - Two identities are inferred, not verified: who the familial address in xenia-helly.html refers to, and who owns the linked GitHub account.
